label: v4 swap frontend adapter
summary: Framework-neutral runtime validation for owner-confirmed chain, PoolId, route hash, quote block, exactness, amount, limit, deadline and hookData-bound swap intents.
maturityMeaning: Deterministic reusable source is packaged and hash-bound; project integration, tests and review are still required.
dependencyRequirements: Pinned project-specific Uniswap v4 SDK and router adapter
Reviewed Universal Router and v4-periphery dependency closure rather than sibling source-head assumptions
requiredFacts: Bind quote and execution to one chain, PoolKey, route hash, hookData, quote block number and quote block hash
Persist the complete user-confirmed intent and require execution to match its exactness, amounts, limit, deadline and route-bound fields
Use user-visible exact-input or exact-output limits and a finite deadline
Keep hooked-pool math and provider support as separately evidenced states
Require downstream exact-output full-fill evidence at every hop, including repeated-currency routes where intermediate underfill can net away
Require bounded router decoding before static-head, dynamic-offset, array-length, multiplication and short-selector reads
Require signedRouteContext consumers to authenticate PoolManager as callback caller and Universal Router as callback sender
hardConflictPredicates: Execution can change chain, PoolId, route hash, hookData, quote block number or quote block hash after user confirmation
A runtime value outside exact-input or exact-output passes TypeScript-only assumptions
Exact-input execution can settle below the confirmed minimum output
Exact-output execution can settle above the confirmed maximum input
Exact-output completion is claimed without full-fill-or-revert evidence for every hop and repeated-currency routes
Untrusted router bytes are read or acted on before every relevant bound and overflow check
A signedRouteContext consumer accepts only PoolManager identity or only Universal Router identity
